description: No Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) process exists for processing operations likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms. Article 35.1 requires controllers to carry out DPIAs before processing.
applicability: Applicable when processing operations are likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms, including systematic evaluation, large-scale processing of special categories, or systematic monitoring of public areas.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data protection governance framework and absence of DPIA procedures for high-risk processing activities.
